summary: The source-bounded semantic chain remains general rather than fixed Q&A. A current-strength question with verified comparative evidence, and its consecutive ratio or leader references, directly answer from the same controlled source data; no model is asked to reinterpret rankings. A topic/build boundary stops the inheritance. A cross-spec DPS, Tier or ranking request is a scope escalation: it clears inherited subject evidence from source planning and can only use a registered same-metric cross-spec comparator. Until such a comparator exists, it returns an immediate evidence boundary rather than a retry, fabricated ranking or reused per-spec value. Raider.IO leaders remain tie-safe, and provider streams retain an end-to-end deadline. Candidate and production both passed the real four-turn stream smoke. The Captain viewport regression is corrected by one flexible internal transcript scroll region, not content-specific styling; its release-configured WeChat package passed mechanics at commit 3fee5c6a. Real WeChat visual acceptance is still required before merge, push or cleanup.
